title: moltkia coerulea
intro: Moltkia coerulea, commonly known as Balkan bugloss, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Moltkia coerulea include its ability to soothe coughs, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
